work.title: Ariettes oubliées
work.movement: II. Il pleure dans mon cœur

version.note: The performing forces are established. The precise edition, any session-specific alteration and the original sounding pitch are not established. The two-record Garden 1904 set is an archival grouping, not a claim that these extracts form a two-movement composition.

performers.note: Both performers are named by the archive, national-library catalogue and specialist discography; no unnamed collaborator is supplied.

date.note: Only the year is established here; no exact day is inferred from a later reissue or modern repository date.

place.note: The city is documented. The studio, street address and recording engineer are not established.

label.note: Original commercial acoustic disc attribution. The 1937 IRCC/RCA carrier catalogued by BnF is a later reissue.

catalogue.note: Original G&T catalogue number. The archive describes a ten-inch disc.

matrixTakeSides.note: Internet Archive’s 3047II disagrees with the 3074 numbering in the discography and Phonobase. This appears consistent with a transposition error in the archive field, but it is not silently corrected. Suffix forms and the actual source disc’s take remain unresolved.

credits.note: The archive names an uploader account but does not identify a transfer engineer. Uploader identity is not converted into a recording or mastering credit.

date.note: The 2019 added/public dates belong to the repository. No date of digitisation of this copy is established.

processing.value: Playback at 74 rpm; stylus-size field “25”; MP3 access file.
processing.note: The source supplies no units for the stylus-size string. Equalisation, noise reduction, pitch correction and equipment are not established. The speed is not treated as proof of the original session’s tuning or tempo.

digital.format: MP3 transfer of a ten-inch acoustic disc

composition.value: Underlying composition and original French words are out of copyright under ordinary life-plus-70 terms; the historical score predates 1926.
composition.note: Debussy died in 1918 and Verlaine in 1896. No modern translation is reproduced; national exceptions and modern editions require separate consideration.

recording.value: Rule 2 — US public domain: original G&T commercial issue dated 1904, before the 1925 cutoff.
recording.note: The original G&T catalogue and 1904 attribution establish a pre-cutoff recording publication basis. The 1937 reissue and 2019 archive upload are not used as the original publication date. No free-recording licence is inferred from a composition-only tag.

rights.creditLine: Claude Debussy, Il pleure dans mon cœur; Mary Garden, soprano, and Claude Debussy, piano. Paris, 1904; G&T 33449; Internet Archive transfer. US pre-1926 publication basis.

sources.title: Internet Archive — Il pleure dans mon cœur
sources.locator: G&T catalogue 33449; date 1904; coverage Paris; Mary Garden and Debussy; soprano/piano; ten-inch disc; transfer at 74 rpm; stylus string 25 without stated units. The 2019 repository dates are not session or transfer dates.

sources.title: Bibliothèque nationale de France — historical Debussy recording catalogue
sources.locator: Subnotice 6 names Mary Garden, soprano, and Claude Debussy, piano, recorded in 1904. Its carrier is the later 1937 RCA/IRCC reissue, not the original G&T disc transferred here.

sources.title: The Record Collector — International Record Collectors Club discography
sources.locator: IRCC 107: Garden, soprano; Debussy, piano; Paris 1904; matrix 3074F; original G&T 33449; later transfer matrix 0EA5670-1.

sources.title: Discography of American Historical Recordings — Mary Garden
sources.locator: Performer entry consulted for discographic cross-checking. Its displayed Victor/Columbia records do not establish the French G&T matrix here; no unrelated American matrix or session date is imported.

sources.title: Debussy — Ariettes oubliées no. 2, voice-and-piano score
sources.locator: Printed pp. 12–17 (PDF 4–9), poem and voice/piano notation inspected visually. Exact edition used at the 1904 session not established.

sources.title: United States Copyright Office — Classics Protection and Access Act
sources.locator: Term: recordings first published before 1923 ceased receiving the specified federal remedies after 31 December 2021. The programme also permits publication through 1925 as of 2026.

sources.title: Phonobase 12051 — Garden/Debussy, G&T 33449
sources.locator: A separate contemporary acoustic copy, Paris 1904, catalogue GC 33449, matrix 3074-ii, 74 rpm. Phonobase’s 2018 digitisation date belongs to that other copy, not to this IA transfer.
